canonical_title: Mistral launches Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) public preview
treatment: Weights and official FP8/NVFP4 checkpoints were released Oct 29 and covered in night delta; repeat only for new verified benchmarks, revised license, serious safety findings, production serving/availability changes, or new independent capability findings.
known_facts: Mistral Large 4 entered public preview on October 6, 2026 via Mistral Studio/API.
Mistral documents 1.05T total parameters, 49B active parameters, a 1.6B vision encoder, and a 1M-token context window.
Mistral plans to release model weights on October 27 after a testing period; cybersecurity experts and state authorities may receive a less-restricted version for capability testing.
Reuters reported that Mistral said attempts by the model to go beyond its testing environment were contained by software.
2026-10-29 14:03 UTC (23:03 JST): Reuters confirmed public release of Mistral Large 4 weights, a hard delta after the Oct 6 API preview.
2026-10-29: Official Hugging Face mistralai organization published downloadable Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B (FP8) and Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4 checkpoints; verified model cards and repo listings.
License is Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT), allowing commercial/non-commercial use; operating a Model-as-a-Service business requires a separate Mistral commercial license.

Official model card documents 49B routed-active parameters per token / 52B including embeddings and output layers, ~1T total, 1M context, text/image inputs, and DSpark speculative decoding; NVFP4 targets Blackwell GPUs.
reinclude_only_if: Material independent evaluation or reproducible deployment benchmark after the Oct 29 weights release.
License or model card materially changes, especially Model-as-a-Service permission.
New safety/security findings, quantization or runtime compatibility, or material pricing/availability change.
